title: Prism Scale
description: Scale configuration mapping data domain values to encoded range values.

scale_type.description: Scale family controlling how domain values map to range values.

domain.description: Explicit domain, pinned outright: exactly two ascending numeric bounds on a continuous scale (linear/log/pow/sqrt), two ISO-8601 or epoch-ms bounds on a time scale, or the ordered category list on a band/point/ordinal scale. An explicit domain overrides the data extent and suppresses both zero and nice.

scheme.description: Categorical or sequential color scheme name.

padding.description: Inner padding fraction for band/point scales.

nice.description: Round the resolved domain outward to human bounds. Defaults to true for linear/pow/sqrt/time and false for log. Boolean only — Vega-Lite's numeric tick-count and time-interval forms are rejected; use axis.tick_count for tick density.

clamp.description: Clamp values outside the domain to the domain extremes.

zero.description: Include zero in the domain. Defaults to true for linear/pow/sqrt; ignored on log (a log domain cannot contain zero) and on time.
